cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @2 (amphoteric), followed by mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @3, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @4, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @5. Cocamidopropylamine Oxide @18 and Sodium Laurate @29 are after the E3 point and recorded only. Counter-signal: three mild anionics.

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful system, prominent payload oils (Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil @7, Persea Gratissima Oil @8), plus light late routes (humectants Glycerin @15, Panthenol @17, Sodium PCA @21; weak refatter PEG-6 Caprylic/Capric Glycerides @25; cationic conditioners Cinnamidopropyltrimonium Chloride @26, Cocamidopropyl Dimethylamine @30; amino acids and Hydrolyzed Keratin @32-36). C2 not met: no cationic polymer and no pearlizing/fatty route. Counter-signal: no cationic polymer or silicone, so slip may be limited; neighbor low.

weightPotential.rationale: moderate: two material plant oils (Argan @7, Avocado @8, both before the W-line @13) in a mild chassis (weak reset) plausibly leave noticeable lipid residue, but there is no silicone and no cationic polymer; the only cationic partners are two late quats (Cinnamidopropyltrimonium Chloride @26, Cocamidopropyl Dimethylamine @30) at trace position, weighed as weak evidence, so W-RICH's partner is not judged plausibly persistent and no second persistent family converges. Moderate confidence, neighbor high (heavier side realistic if the late quats are read as a persistent partner).

excluded: Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Extract @12 (extract, not a nonvolatile oil)
unresolved: Sodium Polystyrene Sulfonate @14 (anionic sulfonated polymer, no cationic charge; post-fragrance; not plausibly band-moving)

weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH would be met if the late quats @26/@30 count as a plausibly persistent cationic partner; with weak reset that would reach the high anchor's rich route.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Material oils under weak reset make residue plausible but bounded.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: high needs a plausibly persistent silicone/cationic partner for W-RICH or two converging persistent families; the only cationic entries are trace-position quats (@26, @30, after the chelators and citric acid) and the proteins are late amino acids. low is excluded: two material oils in a weak-reset chassis.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Whether the late quats count as a plausibly persistent W-RICH partner (judgment; alternative high).
